title: astragalus atropilosulus var. venosus
intro: Astragalus atropilosulus var. venosus, commonly known as the Tibetan milkvetch, is a plant species within the legume family. It is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce fever, and alleviate coughs. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus atropilosulus var. venosus include alkaloids, flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
